best.subject: perf: use a FIFO cache for parsed content-types (#7071)
best.task: perf: use a FIFO cache for parsed content-types As we do for the [content-type parsers]( I propose using a FifoMap here The content-type cache holds far fewer distinct values than its 100 slots in the common case, so eviction order rarely matters and bumping entries on every hit is a performance penalty (albeit small) that we pay for no reason at all as far as I can tell
